ITEMS.Q: What's the difference between Free and Professional?
ITEMS.A: The free SEO Audit & Optimize tier already includes a full crawl (up to 500 pages), technical and on-page findings, a prioritized action plan, an AI-written summary, keyword ideas, audit history, and a PDF report -- everything we've built so far. Professional adds a longer roadmap of deeper crawler capabilities (scheduling, JavaScript rendering, Google Analytics/Search Console integrations, and more) as we build them -- see the Professional card for the full list.

ITEMS.Q: Can I re-run the audit later?
ITEMS.A: Yes. Your payment covers unlimited audits on that website going forward, so you can re-run one after making changes and see your score improve.

ITEMS.Q: Does the agent fix the issues for me?
ITEMS.A: It gives you a prioritized, plain-language action plan -- what to fix first, why it matters, and how hard each fix is. Generating the actual fixed copy (titles, meta descriptions, alt text) is handled by our SEO Copywriter agent; nothing is ever published to your site without your review and approval.

ITEMS.Q: What if I have more than one website?
ITEMS.A: Free or Professional, each tier covers one website. For multiple sites -- or if you'd rather we handle it ongoing -- get in touch and we'll scope it.

ITEMS.Q: How long does an audit take to run?
ITEMS.A: A few minutes for most sites, depending on how many pages are being crawled. You'll see the audit's status update live once it starts.
